title: Pharmacy Packaging and Medication Record Setup: The Amount Charged per Stay
content:
The medication setup charge on a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement pays for pharmacy packaging and the medication administration record of the stay. It appears once on the stay statement as an add-on line.

## The amount

The medication setup charge is the packaging charge, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final total. The packaging charge is the medication setup fee of the stay type, charged once for the stay.

## Worked statements (hypothetical stays)

| Stay type | Medication setup fee of the stay type (fee schedule) | Medication setup charge on the statement |
|---|---|---|
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | 85.00 | 85.00, once |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | 85.00 | 85.00, once |

## Points of reading

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| How many medication setup charges does a stay carry? | One |
| Does an extension of the stay add a second one? | No; the charge is once per stay |
| On which account does it appear? | The stay account of the respite or trial stay |
